title: The Science Behind Recovery
subtitle: Research-backed explanations of cold exposure, sauna use, contrast therapy, red light therapy, sleep, performance, and recovery routines.
intro: ThermaPeak uses peer-reviewed research to explain how recovery methods like cold-water immersion, sauna bathing, contrast therapy, and red light therapy support real-world wellness and performance routines.
why_this_matters: Recovery products are most useful when they help people apply studied protocols consistently. ThermaPeak connects scientific findings to practical product features such as temperature control, insulation, heating performance, comfort, sanitation, and ease of ownership.
methodology: We prioritize peer-reviewed human research, systematic reviews, meta-analyses, randomized trials, and large cohort studies when available.
We summarize what the research found in plain language and connect those findings to practical product features and recovery routines.
We link directly to the underlying papers whenever possible so readers can review the original research.
We distinguish between product categories that enable studied protocols and specific products that have been directly tested.
We avoid disease-treatment claims and focus on consumer-relevant outcomes such as soreness, perceived recovery, sleep, relaxation, heat exposure, and routine consistency.
